description: Nine fronts-style clocks of 7 steps. Slots resolve against the campaign frame.

steps.text: Strange noises and cold drafts begin near {site.clue}.
Animals flee and sleepers dream of the same dark hall.
{villain.name}'s agents seal off {site.clue} and ask no questions.
The first villagers walk off at night and are found standing in a field, silent.
{region.name} sinks into a long dusk; lamps burn low and the dead stir.
{villain.name} breaks the last seal beneath {site.stronghold}.
What slept below walks free, and {region.short} becomes its country.
Candles, chalk and missing scholars appear near {site.clue}.
{villain.name}'s circle holds its first gathering under a covered moon.
A second circle forms in {home.name} and starts recruiting openly.
The omens turn public: lights in the sky, wells that sing at midnight.
The circle gathers the last component, {artifact.name}.
The ritual begins at {site.stronghold} on the appointed night.
The rite completes, and {villain.name} gets exactly what was promised.
A fragment of {artifact.name} turns up and word spreads.
Three factions send agents to the region, and one of them is quietly deadly.
{villain.name} collects the first piece and silences the finder.
A rival claims the second piece, and the region teeters on open conflict.
{villain.name} learns where the last piece rests.
The pieces are brought together at {site.stronghold}.
{villain.name} wields {artifact.name}, and no one can say no.
The old ruler's funeral passes; {villain.name} is first to the high seat.
Loyal officials are quietly retired or reassigned.
A decree forbids anyone from speaking of the missing heir.
Guards begin arresting travelers who ask the wrong questions.
{villain.name} announces a coronation and invites every faction.
Dissenters are locked in {site.stronghold} awaiting the ceremony.
The coronation completes; a new regime begins and the old one is erased.
Crops yellow near {site.clue}; healers shrug.
The sickness reaches the outskirts of {home.name}.
Wells and streams turn bitter, and rumors accuse neighbors.
{villain.name} offers a cure, and the desperate begin paying.
Half of {region.name} is under quarantine and quarrels break out.
The source of the blight is moved to {site.stronghold}, beyond reach.
The land fails; {villain.name} stands as its only hope, and its only owner.
Another traveler vanishes; the bounty on the beast is raised.
The ledger trail leads to a respected name in {home.name}.
A witness is silenced before they can speak.
{villain.name}'s people steer the hunt away from the truth.
The beast is blamed for something it could not have done.
A scapegoat is arrested and a false end to the hunt is announced.
The conspiracy closes behind a tidy lie; {villain.name} escapes and begins again.
A skirmish at the border leaves three dead.
Each side recalls its envoys and stockpiles grain.
{villain.name}'s agents forge letters that inflame both sides.
A caravan is burned and the blame is carefully placed.
Armies march and refugees reach {home.name}.
The decisive meeting is set at {site.stronghold}, and {villain.name} plans to be there.
The first great battle is fought, and {villain.name} gets the war they wanted.
Compasses spin and shadows lean the wrong way near {site.clue}.
Strange lights hang over the old standing place.
Something peers through, and a few folk go missing.
Small things from elsewhere begin crossing over, bold and curious.
{villain.name} opens a second seam above {home.name}.
{artifact.name} is placed at {site.stronghold} to hold the door.
The breach opens fully, and {region.short} joins the other side.
A shop burns on Tin Street; no one saw anything.
Protection is demanded from stalls and wagons alike.
The two crews clash openly, and the watch looks away.
{villain.name}'s hand shows in bribed officials.
Honest merchants flee and prices soar.
The crews are offered a truce arranged by {villain.name} at {site.stronghold}.
Both crews swear to {villain.name}, and the whole region pays.
